title: Ski sponsorship application
slide_intent: Carry a brand through an active sporting scene so its identifying colors and name remain visible amid movement and equipment.
strategic_value: Swisscom’s presence in a Swiss sporting context can reinforce the connection to Swiss heritage described by the agency.
demonstration: A skier turns through a slalom gate with snow spraying behind. The Swisscom name appears on the bib and sleeve, while red, blue and white graphics extend across the clothing.
practical_value: Assess which brand cues remain legible when clothing bends, equipment overlaps it and the subject is photographed in action.

content_islands.name: Skier and branded clothing
content_islands.spec: Keep the skier dominant at left-center, retaining the Swisscom name on the chest and sleeve and the colored clothing panels.

content_islands.name: Sporting context
content_islands.spec: Preserve the gate poles, skis, hand-held poles and snow spray so the identity is read within its actual use setting.

content_islands.name: Open snow-spray field
content_islands.spec: Leave the wider blue field to the right of the skier, showing the direction and space of the photographed turn.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying “Emotional connection” text explicitly connects the transformation to customer engagement and pride in Swiss heritage.
reference_purposes.Expression: Red, blue and white graphics repeat across the skier’s clothing.
reference_purposes.Application: The photograph places the name and graphics on clothing and equipment during a sporting event.
